details.story: As a Consumer, I want to sort search results by relevance, downloads, or last updated, so that I can find the most appropriate or active data packages quickly.
details.reason: Search and download counts exist but no sorting capability is specified.

details.story: As a Consumer, I want to see a data package's license and attribution requirements before downloading, so that I can comply with the usage terms.
details.reason: Consumers need licensing information before they can responsibly use data.

details.story: As a Publisher, I want to specify a license for my data package, so that consumers know how they can legally use it.
details.reason: Publishing workflows lack explicit license selection metadata.

details.story: As a Consumer, I want to preview the tabular data contents of a data package online, so that I can understand the data structure before downloading.
details.reason: Viewing package metadata exists but not previewing the actual data online.

details.story: As a Consumer, I want to download only a subset of a data package's resources, so that I do not have to download unnecessary files.
details.reason: Whole-package download exists but selective resource download is missing.

details.story: As a Publisher, I want to upload resource files directly through the UI when creating a data package, so that I can publish data without using the CLI.
details.reason: UI creation and publishing exist but not direct file upload.

details.story: As an Owner, I want to invite a user to join my publisher as a member, so that they can collaborate on my data packages.
details.reason: Owner role management exists but no publisher-specific invitation flow is defined.

details.story: As an Owner, I want to transfer ownership of my publisher or data package to another user, so that the project can continue if I leave.
details.reason: Role changes exist but full ownership transfer is missing.

details.story: As a Publisher, I want to see download counts and other metrics for my own data packages, so that I can understand usage and improve my data.
details.reason: Consumers can see download popularity but publishers lack analytics.

details.story: As a Consumer, I want to get a citation for a data package, so that I can properly attribute it in my work.
details.reason: Data analysis workflows imply the need for formal citation.

details.story: As a Consumer, I want to report an issue with a data package, so that the publisher can correct errors or quality problems.
details.reason: There is no consumer feedback channel for data quality issues.

details.story: As a Publisher, I want to see and respond to issues reported on my data packages, so that I can improve data quality and communicate fixes.
details.reason: Consumer reporting needs a publisher response workflow.

details.story: As a Developer, I want to obtain an API token for programmatic access to the registry, so that I can publish or manage data packages from scripts.
details.reason: Client configuration exists but no API authentication story is defined.

details.story: As a Developer, I want to use a REST API to search and access registry metadata, so that I can integrate data packages into my applications.
details.reason: Node and R libraries exist but no general public API story is specified.

details.story: As a Publisher, I want to set a data package's visibility to public, private, or unlisted, so that I can control who can discover and access it.
details.reason: Public and private packages exist but unlisted or more granular visibility is missing.

details.story: As an Admin, I want to suspend a user or remove content that violates terms, so that I can keep the platform safe and trusted.
details.reason: Admin invite and configuration exist but no moderation actions are defined.

details.story: As an Admin, I want to set storage quotas or rate limits for publishers, so that I can manage platform resources and pricing tiers.
details.reason: Pricing and billing exist but no quota enforcement story is specified.

details.story: As a Consumer, I want to follow or subscribe to a publisher, so that I can be notified when they publish new or updated data packages.
details.reason: Package-level change notifications exist but publisher-level subscriptions are missing.

details.story: As a Consumer, I want to browse data packages by topic or tag, so that I can discover relevant datasets without a specific search term.
details.reason: Search exists but browsing by category or tag is not covered.

details.story: As a Publisher, I want to add a changelog or release notes when publishing a new version, so that consumers know what changed.
details.reason: Versioning and change notifications exist but release note content is missing.

details.story: As a Consumer, I want to verify the integrity of a downloaded data package using a checksum or signature, so that I can trust that it has not been corrupted or tampered with.
details.reason: Publisher-side validation exists but consumer-side download integrity checking is missing.

details.story: As a Web Developer, I want to embed a live view or preview of a data package in an external website, so that I can share data with my audience without them leaving my site.
details.reason: View previews exist for publishers and consumers but embedding is not covered.

details.story: As a Data Analyst, I want to query a data package using SQL over the registry API, so that I can aggregate and analyze data without downloading the full package.
details.reason: SQLite download exists but remote SQL querying is missing.

details.story: As an OlderPerson, I want ALFRED to help me set up a recurring social activity, so that I can regularly meet people with similar interests.
details.reason: Social groups and event organization exist but recurring activity setup is not covered.

details.story: As an OlderPerson, I want to invite selected contacts to a meeting or event through ALFRED, so that the group can agree on the details.
details.reason: Organizing meetings is covered but explicit invitation sending is missing.

details.story: As an OlderPerson, I want to share my live location with trusted contacts when I travel using ALFRED, so that they know I arrived safely.
details.reason: Navigation and location exist for caregivers but user-initiated location sharing is missing.

details.story: As an OlderPerson, I want ALFRED to remind me to drink water during the day, so that I stay hydrated.
details.reason: Health reminders exist but hydration is not covered.

details.story: As an OlderPerson, I want ALFRED to track my sleep patterns, so that I can discuss them with a caregiver if needed.
details.reason: Vital monitoring exists but sleep tracking is not specified.

details.story: As an OlderPerson, I want ALFRED to automatically detect a fall and alert the nearest caregiver, so that I get help even when I cannot call myself.
details.reason: Emergency contact exists but automatic fall detection is missing.

details.story: As an OlderPerson, I want ALFRED to remind me when a medicine package is nearly empty, so that I can order a refill on time.
details.reason: Medicine reminders exist but refill reminders are not covered.

details.story: As an OlderPerson, I want to schedule medical appointments in ALFRED and receive reminders, so that I do not miss a doctor visit.
details.reason: Appointment reminders exist but medical appointment scheduling is missing.

details.story: As a MedicalCaregiver, I want to receive an alert when the user's vital signs are outside the normal range, so that I can intervene quickly.
details.reason: Vital data is collected but threshold-based alerts for caregivers are missing.

details.story: As a MedicalCaregiver, I want to set the patient's medication schedule in ALFRED, so that the reminders follow the care plan.
details.reason: Medicine adherence is visible to caregivers but schedule setting is not covered.

details.story: As a MedicalCaregiver, I want to view the user's historical vital data, so that I can see trends and adjust care.
details.reason: Caregivers receive current data but historical trend views are missing.

details.story: As a MedicalCaregiver, I want to have a secure video consultation with the older person through ALFRED, so that I can provide care remotely.
details.reason: Videophone is mentioned but privacy-preserving remote consultation is not specified.

details.story: As a SocialCaregiver, I want to be alerted if the user shows signs of social isolation or prolonged inactivity, so that I can offer support.
details.reason: Activity feedback and social activities exist but isolation alerts are missing.

details.story: As an OlderPerson, I want ALFRED to track my blood pressure with a connected sensor, so that I can share this vital data with my doctor.
details.reason: Heart rate and vital data are monitored but blood pressure is not mentioned.

details.story: As an OlderPerson, I want ALFRED to count my daily steps and show my progress, so that I can stay physically active.
details.reason: A step counter exists for social caregivers but the older person's own progress view is missing.

details.story: As an OlderPerson, I want ALFRED to suggest low-impact exercises based on my health conditions, so that I can exercise safely.
details.reason: Health tips and training exist but condition-specific exercise suggestions are not covered.

details.story: As an OlderPerson, I want ALFRED to adjust my training plan based on my performance, so that exercises remain suitable and motivating.
details.reason: Training performance is shown but adaptive plan adjustment is missing.

details.story: As a developer, I want to test my app in a sandbox environment before publishing, so that I can find issues without affecting real users.
details.reason: App creation and support exist but a safe testing environment is missing.

details.story: As a developer, I want to receive user feedback and ratings for my app, so that I can improve it based on real usage.
details.reason: App presentation and crash information exist but user feedback collection is missing.

details.story: As a developer, I want to view anonymized usage analytics for my app, so that I can understand which features are used most.
details.reason: App state notifications exist but usage analytics are not covered.

details.story: As a developer, I want to manage app versions and staged updates, so that I can roll out improvements gradually.
details.reason: Creating and maintaining apps is mentioned but version management is missing.

details.story: As a developer, I want clear documentation and code samples for the ALFRED API, so that I can develop apps more quickly.
details.reason: High-level API and development support exist but detailed documentation is not specified.

details.story: As a developer, I want to declare and manage the permissions my app requires from the older person, so that data access is transparent.
details.reason: Access to OS features and user settings exist but permission declaration is missing.

details.story: As an OlderPerson, I want ALFRED to read out text from letters or documents, so that I can understand printed information despite visual trouble.
details.reason: Visual support and speech interaction exist but document reading is not covered.

details.story: As an OlderPerson, I want to set quiet hours during which ALFRED only reacts to emergencies, so that I am not disturbed during rest.
details.reason: Listening control and customization exist but quiet hours are missing.

details.story: As a MedicalCaregiver, I want to receive a reminder for follow-up care tasks for the user, so that I can keep the care plan on schedule.
details.reason: Caregivers see medicine adherence but follow-up task reminders are not covered.
